editionLabel: Underdog English first edition, 8-page legacy download
firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently went to an airport goes first.
houseFallback: If nobody qualifies, the timing is tied or unclear, or your group prefers another approach, agree to choose randomly. This is this site’s suggested house rule.
clarifications: That player also places their Trekker on an Airport first during setup. Others place theirs clockwise, with only one Trekker per Airport.
Regular turns begin with the same first player and continue clockwise.
The criterion concerns going to an airport; it does not require taking a flight.

internalEvidence: Complete publisher-hosted or publisher-linked PDF retrieved; relevant setup, opening-turn, variant and edition pages read and visually inspected. Reviewed PDF pages: 1, 2, 4, 7, 8. Setup step 2 selects the latest airport visitor and orders starting Trekker placement clockwise. Gameplay separately confirms that this player begins clockwise individual turns. The souvenir-count tie-break concerns final scoring only. Unlike Trekking the National Parks, this game ends after the triggering player finishes their turn; no equal-turn final round is asserted. The publisher’s legacy navigation identifies this download as first edition. The PDF credits identify Underdog but state no printing year.
